questions.prompt: What is the last (unit) digit of \(47^{308}\)?
questions.explanation: The last digit of \(47\) is \(7\); its powers end in \(7,9,3,1\) and repeat (cyclicity \(4\)). \(308=4\times77+0\), so take place \(4\): last digit \(1\).

questions.prompt: Find the sum of the binomial coefficients at the even places (r = 0, 2, 4, ...) of \((1+x)^{5}\).
questions.explanation: Even-place sum = odd-place sum, and together they make \(2^{5}\), so each is \(2^{4}=16\).

questions.prompt: What is the last (unit) digit of \(89^{220}\)?
questions.explanation: The last digit of \(89\) is \(9\); its powers end in \(9,1\) and repeat (cyclicity \(2\)). \(220=2\times110+0\), so take place \(2\): last digit \(1\).

questions.prompt: How many terms are there in the expansion of \((x+y)^{9}-(x-y)^{9}\) after simplification?
questions.explanation: The terms with even powers of \(y\) cancel and the odd ones double, so \(\lfloor(9+1)/2\rfloor=5\) terms remain.

questions.prompt: If \(\binom{37}{x}=\binom{37}{7}\) and \(x\ne 7\), find \(x\).
questions.explanation: \(\binom{37}{x}=\binom{37}{7}\Rightarrow x=7\ \text{or}\ x=37-7=30\)
